_comment: What analysts say about the other side's hardware (design.md 2.9, Foreign hardware; ui-spec.md 4.15). A draft for the user's review, not read by the game yet. Outside the pack, like front-pages.json: corrections reach running games. One entry per program and rocket program, by id, on either side. role is a short plain line on what it does. counterpart is the id of the nearest equivalent on the other side, or null: the player's side shows its name, 'their counterpart to your Mercury'. Pairs need not be mutual: several can share one counterpart.
